author: Kerrie_R

title: Very entertaining and informative!  Highly recommend!
text:
We were greeted by friendly staff. The process of making Jamón was very interesting and well explained. This was very entertaining and informative. 

Well worth the half hour!
author: Karen_S

title: Perfetta combinazione con la visita alla Sagrada Familia! Top!
text:
What an astonishing experience! 
Never tried an ham like this. Actually the staff - absolutely amazing and kind at any moment - told me to forget about saying ham, because they say “ham is not jamón”!!
In effect it is “another world”, delicious, tasty and completely different front what can be eaten around the globe. Moreover this tasting experience is very helpful to understand the Spanish tradition about Jamón Pata Negra learning all the difference between all categories!
